scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix apps/web install && npm --prefix apps/cms install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,cms -c blue,green "npm --prefix apps/web run dev" "npm --prefix apps/cms run develop"
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/web run build && npm --prefix apps/cms run build
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n web,cms -c blue,green "npm --prefix apps/web run start" "npm --prefix apps/cms run start"
